body.statement: Characterize the set of \((\alpha,\beta,\gamma,d)\) for which \(\rho_\star(n)\asymp r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)\), and on its complement derive the exact nuisance-limited exponent with any boundary logarithm. The characterization must distinguish \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) separately whenever two laws with the same sum \(\alpha+\beta\) have different testing difficulty. On each phase, compare minimax-detectable sequences in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\) with Yu's learner condition \(\mathsf Y_n\) only on laws satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}(P)\); at \(V(P)\asymp r_n^2\), record separately Yu's root-\(n\) signal requirement \(\sqrt n\,r_n^2\to\infty\). Compare the same sequences with Dhawan--Guo--Shah only on the intersection satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\). For DGS, use the DGS score-translation lemma: at \(V(P)\asymp r_n^2\), Corollary 2 additionally requires \(\operatorname{Corr}_P(s_P(U),\xi_P(U)\mid\widehat h_n)>\kappa_n\) with high probability and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\). Establish every claimed strict inclusion or non-inclusion by legal sequences in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\), using a dense orthogonal bump pack against the hunted direction and a one-direction aligned alternative as the comparison handle; if either construction fails the full-law lift or a published applicability condition, report that relation as unresolved rather than asserting it. Separate uniform omnibus power from favorable-direction pointwise power.
body.justification: The phase map must distinguish statistical hardness from the sufficient learner and alignment conditions imposed by currently implementable first-order procedures.
body.gap: Yu2026VarianceHTE, Assumption 4 and Theorem 1 require separate learner remainders and additional boundary nondegeneracy, while DhawanGuoShah2026, Corollary 2 applies to its projected score on \(U\) under \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\), conditional correlation above \(\kappa_n\), and \(n\kappa_n^2V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P)\to\infty\); neither paper locates these sufficient regimes relative to the Hölder minimax radius or proves a class inclusion.
body.consumer: The resulting verified relation map tells users of the Yu variance test and \(\texttt{dScoreTest}\) when their guarantees reach the omnibus frontier, when favorable alignment yields different pointwise power, and when corrected energy is required.
